description: This may be the primary source code file defining the 'Alert' class, which manages alert messages within the OpenMRS framework, including properties such as text, recipients, and read status.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Represents a notification alert with properties such as text, recipients, expiration date, and flags indicating read status and satisfaction criteria.

methods.name: getAlertId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this alert.

methods.name: setAlertId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this alert.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the user who created the alert.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the user who created the alert.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the alert.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the alert.

methods.name: getDateToExpire
methods.description: Returns the expiration date of the alert.

methods.name: setDateToExpire
methods.description: Sets the expiration date of the alert.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the alert message text.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the alert message text.

methods.name: getSatisfiedByAny
methods.description: Returns whether the alert is satisfied when any recipient satisfies it.

methods.name: isSatisfiedByAny
methods.description: Checks if the alert is satisfied by any recipient.

methods.name: setSatisfiedByAny
methods.description: Sets whether the alert is satisfied when any recipient satisfies it.

methods.name: getAlertRead
methods.description: Returns whether the alert has been read.

methods.name: isAlertRead
methods.description: Checks if the alert is marked as read.

methods.name: setAlertRead
methods.description: Marks the alert as read or unread.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who last changed the alert.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who last changed the alert.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when the alert was last changed.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when the alert was last changed.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Returns the set of recipients of this alert.

methods.name: setRecipients
methods.description: Sets the recipients of this alert.

methods.name: addRecipient
methods.description: Adds a recipient to the alert.

methods.name: addRecipient
methods.description: Adds a user as a recipient to the alert.

methods.name: removeRecipient
methods.description: Removes a recipient from the alert.

methods.name: getRecipient
methods.description: Finds the AlertRecipient object for a given user.

methods.name: markAlertRead
methods.description: Marks the alert as read for the authenticated user.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the alert.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier as per OpenMRS object interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier as per OpenMRS object interface.
